content_voiceover: This is an actual question from the 112, or 2023, board exam, testing the I C C 2022 classification of M D S, again using the multiple true false format. Statement one says lower risk M D S has been simplified into three subtypes, two defined mainly by genetic features, S F 3 B 1 mutation and del 5 q, with the remainder classified as M D S not otherwise specified, this is true and reflects the I C C's genetically driven simplification. Statement two defines M D S with excess blasts as five to nineteen percent myeloid blasts in the bone marrow, or two to nine percent in peripheral blood, or one percent documented on two separate occasions, but this blurs together separate I C C thresholds, the actual I C C twenty twenty two peripheral blood range for the lower excess blasts category is two to four percent, not two to nine percent, so this statement is false as written. Statement three claims the prior entity of M D S with ring sideroblasts has been replaced by M D S with S R S F 2 mutation, this is also false, ring sideroblast M D S is actually now defined by S F 3 B 1 mutation, not S R S F 2, that's the trap. Statement four, about multi hit T P 53 predicting aggressive disease and short survival, is true. Statement five, about diagnosing M D S without proven clonality if dysplasia and cytopenia qualify, is also true. So the wrong statements are two and three, matching answer key B.
keypoints: Question tests ICC 2022 classification criteria for MDS
Statement 3 is the key trap: MDS-RS is now defined by SF3B1 mutation, not SRSF2
Statement 2 misstates the ICC peripheral blood blast threshold, actual range is 2 to 4 percent, not 2 to 9 percent
Multi-hit TP53 in cytopenic myeloid neoplasms predicts aggressive, short-survival disease
Answer key marks B, statements 2 and 3, as the wrong pair
keypoint_voiceover: The key trap to remember, in I C C 2022, ring sideroblast M D S is redefined around S F 3 B 1 mutation status, not S R S F 2, so any statement pairing ring sideroblasts with S R S F 2 is a distractor. Also watch the exact peripheral blood blast cutoff, it's two to four percent for the lower excess blasts category, not the looser two to nine percent range, since these precise numbers get tested directly.
